description: This Java class 'LoanProductInterestRecalculationData' holds configuration data related to interest recalculation for loan products in the financial software. It encapsulates various settings including frequency, methods, and strategies for interest recalculation, as well as related flags and options.

classes.name: LoanProductInterestRecalculationData
classes.description: Data class encapsulating interest recalculation settings for a loan product, including frequency, strategy, and boolean flags.

methods.name: sensibleDefaultsForNewLoanProductCreation
methods.description: Provides default values for creating a new loan product interest recalculation configuration.

methods.name: isArrearsBasedOnOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Getter indicating if arrears are based on the original schedule.

methods.name: isCompoundingToBePostedAsTransaction
methods.description: Getter indicating if interest compounding should be posted as a transaction.

methods.description: Getter for the flag controlling interest calculation disallowance on past due.
